department: Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026; late applications are not accepted.
deadline.quote: Application Deadline: December 1st | Late applications will not be accepted or considered

app_fee.value: The fee is waived for PhD candidates for Fall 2027 admission.
app_fee.quote: the fee will be waived for PhD candidates for Fall 2027 admissions.

fee_waiver.value: PhD applicants pay no fee for Fall 2027.
fee_waiver.quote: the fee will be waived for PhD candidates for Fall 2027 admissions.

gre_general.value: The department no longer requires GRE scores for PhD or master's applicants.
gre_general.quote: The CHBE department no longer requires applicants to submit GRE scores for its PhD or Master’s graduate programs.

supervisor.value: Contacting faculty is not required but encouraged; advisers are matched during the first year.
supervisor.quote: The Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering does not require students to contact faculty members before applying. However, you are encouraged to reach out to faculty related to your areas of interest.

funding.value: Most PhD students receive support throughout the calendar year: assistantship stipend plus tuition and insurance grant, for up to ten semesters.
funding.quote: Most graduate students enrolled in the PhD program of the Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering at Rice University receive financial support throughout the calendar year.

entry_route.value: PhD applicants are admitted with or without a master's degree; coursework differs.
entry_route.quote: admits applicants seeking the Ph.D. degree regardless of whether or not they hold a master’s degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study
